message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the appropriate charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: Chen, operating a clothing processing factory, hired workers, owed wages 85,361 RMB to 15 workers, escaped, later partially paid 51,000 RMB, remaining owed with IOU. The labor bureau ordered payment, he didn't pay. This is refusal to pay labor wages. The label in list: "拒不支付劳动报酬". Indeed earlier examples: "拒不支付劳动报酬" used for similar cases. So the charge is "拒不支付劳动报酬". Any other charges? Possibly "逃匿" but not a charge. The main is refusal to pay wages. So answer single label.

Thus final answer: [罪名]拒不支付劳动报酬<eoa>.
